'''2016 MPC Scott Lingrell DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
